resources.string: Double-tap the floating button to capture

To get started:

1. Tap the button above to open Accessibility Settings
2. Find "DoubleTap Screenshot" in the list
3. Toggle it ON and confirm
4. A small camera icon will appear on your screen
5. Double-tap it anytime to take a screenshot

You can drag the icon to reposition it anywhere on screen.

The floating trigger is active on your screen.

Double-tap the camera icon to take a screenshot.
Drag it to move it anywhere.

To disable, tap the button above and turn off the service.
Displays a floating button on screen. Double-tap it to take a screenshot. The service does not collect or transmit any data.
